reviews.review:
Game dead.

Absolute hidden gem in my opinion. I don't think this game deserves the hate that it got, especially today. When you play this game for what it is and treat it as its own game and not like Left 4 Dead 2, you'll definitely enjoy this game more, especially with the cards system changing how the way you play the game. If you enjoy zombie shooters, games with various playstyles, and a bit of challenge, this one is for you. 

However, I cannot recommend buying this game in full price. Developers have stopped making content for the game and the game is left in a stand still. I recommend buying this game when it's in a discount.

But for what this game is, this is DEFINITELY worth a shot.

Ok so I wanted to own this game as it was a very important albeit small segment of what kept me somewhat sane during the pandemic and with that being said I had to say that it suffered from several issues from day 1. 
I can recall being super excited about "the spiritual sequel to left 4 dead franchise" with the same team that brought to life, well, one of the most fun and re playable games ever,that being, Left 4 Dead, hell I was just super hyped about the devs saying, and I'm paraphrasing here but I still remember the promotional interviews with them saying "left 4 dead is back" and that was problem number 1 even before launch: making your fans believe you were going to release another iteration of left 4 dead so when the launch date came...oh boy was it something else but not in a good launch kind of way as in the difficulty was so broken back then and to this day it still is because it was not the well crafted difficulty that makes a game cohesive, it was chaos. Do you remember the ex csgo pro player "Shroud"? Even he did a test run during the launch and I guess the video must be there somewhere and even he, a freaking FPS pro player found the game horribly unbalanced just like everyone else did. I am an ex Halo HCS myself and I was taken aback by how damn weird the game felt as it has modern gunplay, the hit scan is pretty good, the weapon roster is ♥♥♥♥♥♥♥ fun to use and you can upgrade it during your run and the characters interact and have unique dialogues just like in left 4 dead but the devs forgot to mention that this game has a roguelike aspect to it: Your gameplay depends on a deck of cards that boost your abilities but so do the enemies, and the more players in a match  made the hordes and mutations and bosses spawn like crazy to the point that even playing the game on normal was just off and every little patch just moved things around even more and the problem number 2 is that the devs jumped into the hero/operator characters bs that honestly I for one, hate, Why do I hate it? It brought even more unbalance to an fps that depends on balance and teamwork and that the devs, tried to sell as something that put the bar very damn high and it was the time where No Hope difficulty wasn't even a thing in the game.
Once you max out your deck and fine-tune your playstyle, it is still a gamble and will not guarantee a successful run.
Back then maybe 3 months in the game it was very hard to find people that wanted to play higher difficulties because as soon as ANYONE saw an ogre they disconnected from the match or as you may have guessed by now, used a broken character (Holly recovers 1 hp for each kill and Evangelo just runs, and runs and runs) so the gameplay instead of being an fps it boiled down to just kill the ridden needed to trigger certain events and finish the level, a stamina/melee crouched player was the "rule" if you wanted to see the next level.
Now it's been years and the game is VERY FUN, but it's pretty much abandoned by the devs now I will move on to problem number 3: pricing and the weird DLC stuff.
The price is wrong and everyone that has played the base game like I did know that the price is wrong in every way and while the DLC's could have added substantial stuff, it adds 4 other characters that just feel off, "new" weapons which are just reskins of existing ones and 2 more Acts in the campaign that should have been a "we get and respect or fanbase so here AT LEAST GET THE FULL STORY WITHOUT DLC".
Problem 4: The DLC 
Most people that have the dlc either love the game or have money to toss around and let's pretend for a second that in some other universe where the game was not rushed and passed real game testing and the pandemic never happened, and the rest of the story was not another "wanna see how the story really ends? wanna play a bit more? give us money" then and only then the dlc would be optional as it adds stuff like getting inside the ridden nests for extra good stuff.
Problem 5: You may get a BSOD when launching the game on windows 10/11.
I do not know code but a video game is not supposed to do that.
Then with all that information I have provided you may be wondering "then why the thumbs up?!"
The game scratches a very specific spot in good FPS games that when it works, it's brilliant and shows you the gigantic potential this game had and what misleading marketing does.
I bested the base game story solo on Nightmare even when people rip their hair off and just either had to turn the diff down for it to be playable or never ever play the game again, but many people out there think, including myself, that this game is freaking fun and the gunplay is fun.
With all that said due to the problems it presents I must objective and give the game experience as a whole an 8/10 BUT the way it was handled by the devs, by the marketing team, the stupid pricing and the lack of an option to even pause the game when solo (as the game was meant to be played online but as no one wanted to play anymore they added offline) makes the behind-the-scenes of what made this game exist nothing short of a dumpster fire.
But I can't be mean to something that brough me and many more fun when we needed it.
Never pay full price, enter without expectations, and you will have a blast even alone, and call me whatever derogatory term you want but I liked the game.
I hope a sequel happens or by means of magic valve learns to count to 3 before I die.

Really solid and fun game. Grab it on sale and its very much worth it, did not deserve all the hate it got.
(Have a lot of more hours on another platform)
